question: Does the polyhedron_floe3d DEM correctly reproduce (a) linear hydrodynamic drag decay, (b) spring-dashpot restitution, and (c) their combined effect on a floating polyhedral floe?

external_anchors.claim: v(t) = v0 * exp(-c*t/m) for F = -c*v in quiescent fluid
spring-dashpot restitution e = exp(-zeta*pi/sqrt(1-zeta^2)) for underdamped oscillator
submerged fraction at equilibrium = rho_ice / rho_water
drag + buoyancy + gravity form a damped oscillator for heave motion

A_drag_decay.description: Linear drag decay in quiescent fluid matches analytic exponential
A_drag_decay.metric: relative error of v(t) vs v0*exp(-c*t/m) at t=0.2s

B_restitution.description: Coefficient of restitution matches analytic formula for spring-dashpot
B_restitution.metric: relative error of e_measured vs e_analytic(zeta)

C_buoyancy_equilibrium.description: Floating floe settles to Archimedes draft
C_buoyancy_equilibrium.metric: relative error of submerged fraction vs rho_ice/rho_water

D_combined_drag_restitution.description: Impact with drag: peak force and post-impact velocity match coupled analytic prediction
D_combined_drag_restitution.metric: relative error of peak force and post-impact velocity

E_convergence.description: All metrics converge with dt refinement
E_convergence.metric: error at dt/2 < error at dt for all cases

negative_controls: zero drag (c=0) must show no velocity decay in quiescent fluid
zero damping (zeta=0) must give e=1.0 (elastic impact)
neutrally buoyant floe (rho_ice=rho_water) must have zero net buoyancy force

thresholds_declared_before_production_ru.stopping_rule: if any acceptance criterion fails at the base resolution, stop and file honest-FAIL with fail_stage; do not retune parameters to pass

controlled: polyhedron: hexagonal prism, area=0.25 m2, thickness=0.12 m, density=900 kg/m3
drag coefficient c = 0.7 * 2 * m * omega0 (70% of critical damping for heave)
confounders_and_nuisances: leapfrog is symplectic but only first-order accurate for dissipative systems
buoyancy force is exact (tetrahedral clipping) but the work ledger uses midpoint velocity
drag is linear (Stokes-like), not quadratic (Morison); valid for low Re

environment.compute: local (single core), total wall clock < 5 min

analysis_plan: Per case: compute analytic reference, run simulation, measure metric, compute relative error, mark pass/fail. Aggregate: table ref vs got per metric with error column; convergence table over dt; restitution sweep table. Negative controls executed and required to pass (i.e., show the expected null behavior).
